name: Stamina Arcanist Solo / Duo
author: DeadxxSmile / ATTB
summary: Medium-armored Crux builder with dual daggers, an Inferno Staff, strong self-healing, shielding, and a full-strength AoE beam.

concepts.title: Primary resource
concepts.text: Put every attribute point into Stamina. Magicka still pays for utility and back-bar skills; hybrid scaling uses the stronger offensive stats.

concepts.title: Crux loop
concepts.text: Generate three Crux with Runeblades early and Cephaliarch’s Flail later, then spend them on Pragmatic Fatecarver.

concepts.title: Class-line leveling
concepts.text: Keep one skill from Herald of the Tome, Soldier of Apocrypha, and Curative Runeforms on the active bar whenever XP lands.

concepts.title: Weapon identity
concepts.text: The daggers are offensive stat sticks. Most damage comes from Arcanist abilities rather than ordinary dagger attacks.

tips: Join Fighters Guild, Mages Guild, and Undaunted early; train mount Speed every day.
Unlock all three armor lines by equipping three pieces of each weight once, then return to the leveling mix.
Runic Jolt is a taunt. Keep it for Soldier XP but do not use it casually in group dungeons.
Do not buy the Destruction Staff passive Tri Focus for this setup.
Ring of the Pale Order blocks other players from healing you. Coordinate with your duo partner.
ESO Plus accelerates XP and grants DLC access, but Scribing is claimed separately through the current free base-game route.
Recommended Class Mastery: Unbound Potential + Ink-Scribe’s Verve after all three native class lines reach rank 50; subclassing disables them.

class.summary: This build keeps all three native Arcanist skill lines for pure-class progression and Class Mastery access.

race.summary: Race changes damage, sustain, and utility slightly, but ordinary PvE content does not require the recommended option.
notes: Record the race you actually chose; ATTB keeps it separate from the build recommendation.

alliance.summary: Alliance primarily determines PvP faction and some story context. It does not change this PvE combat setup.
notes: Any Race, Any Alliance and Alliance Change Tokens can make race and alliance independent.

mundus.summary: The Thief increases Critical Chance and is the default damage Mundus for this launch build.
notes: Activate a different Mundus stone at any time to replace the current blessing.

front_weapon.summary: The front bar holds the main spammable, class burst, and offensive passives.

back_weapon.summary: The second weapon bar unlocks at character level 15 and normally carries longer-duration effects and support skills.

leveling_armor.summary: Mixed armor weights level multiple armor skill lines while Training traits accelerate experience gain.

endgame_armor.summary: The final weight mix balances damage passives, penetration, sustain, and Undaunted Mettle.

leveling_trait.summary: Training increases experience gained from kills. Replace leveling pieces freely rather than upgrading them heavily.

gear_cap.summary: Equipment stops scaling at Level 50 / CP160, so that is the first point where farming and upgrading permanent sets makes sense.
